newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Eltin wins A$158mln coal mine contract.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Eltin wins A$158mln coal mine contract.

text.p: Contract miner Eltin Ltd said on Friday it had won a A$158 million mining contract at the Ebenezer coal mine in Queensland.
The contract runs for three years commencing in March 1997 and running to March 31, 2000.

The contract is Eltin's first major open cut mining contract in the coal industry and in a statement managing director, Nick Bowen, said the company was looking for further opportunities in the industry.
"We are delighted to have been awarded this contract, which represents the first of what we believe will be many opportunities in the coal industry of New South Wales and Queensland," Bowen said.
About A$50 million worth of new plant and equipment would be required for the Ebenezer contract, Eltin said.
The company also said work in hand of A$925 million was the highest in the company's history.
By 3.15 p.m. (0415 GMT), Eltin shares were five cents higher at A$2.81 on turnover of 28,209 shares.
